name: Edit, revise & improve
instruction: Edit, revise, and improve the selected text. Keep my meaning, make it clearer and more fluent, and avoid making it sound overly polished or corporate.

name: Shorten & make punchier
instruction: Make the selected text shorter, sharper, and more direct while keeping the main point.

name: Turn rough notes into a comment
instruction: Turn the selected notes into a clear online comment. Keep my argument intact, improve the flow, and make it sound natural.

name: Improve review or product comment
instruction: Edit and improve the selected product review. Keep it honest, useful, and balanced. Make it clearer and easier to scan without exaggerating.

name: Reply to selected comment
instruction: Write a reply to the selected comment. Be clear, firm, and persuasive. Push back on the claim without sounding unhinged.

name: Sarcastic reply
instruction: Write a sarcastic reply to the selected comment. Keep it witty, cutting, and not too long.

name: Polite but firm reply
instruction: Write a polite but firm reply to the selected text. Be clear, reasonable, and direct.

name: Expand & strengthen argument
instruction: Expand and strengthen the selected argument. Keep the tone conversational, add clearer reasoning, and avoid sounding like an essay.

name: Challenge this claim
instruction: Challenge the selected claim. Identify the weak assumptions, misleading framing, and any missing context. Keep the response concise and suitable as an online comment.

name: Fact-check / sanity-check
instruction: Fact-check the selected claim. Explain what is true, what is misleading, and what context is missing. Keep it concise. Use web search when current or reliable verification is needed, and include links to the most relevant sources when web results are used.

name: Make less aggressive
instruction: Rewrite the selected text so it is less aggressive but still firm and critical.

name: Make more direct
instruction: Rewrite the selected text to be more direct, sharper, and harder-hitting without becoming abusive.

name: Improve clarity
instruction: Rewrite the selected text to make it clearer and easier to understand without removing important detail.

name: Professional tone
instruction: Rewrite the selected text in a polished, professional tone while keeping it natural and direct.

name: Friendly tone
instruction: Rewrite the selected text in a warm, friendly, and approachable tone without sounding artificial.

name: Correct grammar
instruction: Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and obvious usage errors while changing as little else as possible.

name: More formal
instruction: Rewrite the selected text in a more formal register while preserving its meaning.

name: Explain this technical issue
instruction: Explain the selected technical issue in practical terms. Give likely causes, what to check first, and what not to waste time on.

name: Troubleshooting checklist
instruction: Create a practical troubleshooting checklist for the selected problem. Start with the quickest and lowest-risk checks.

name: Compare options
instruction: Compare the selected options. Give the practical pros and cons, then recommend the best choice for my situation. If important context about my situation is missing, state the assumption behind the recommendation.

name: Reply to email
instruction: Treat the selected text as an email I received and draft my reply. Keep it professional, natural, and appropriately concise. Address the important points and do not invent facts, commitments, dates, or attachments.

name: Formal email reply
instruction: Treat the selected text as an email I received and draft a formal reply in British English. Be courteous, precise, and appropriately structured without sounding stiff. Do not invent facts or commitments.

name: Follow up or polite reminder
instruction: Draft a polite follow-up or reminder based on the selected text. Make the requested next step clear, acknowledge any relevant timing, and avoid sounding impatient or passive-aggressive.

name: Reply to customer message
instruction: Treat the selected text as a customer or client message and draft my reply. Be courteous, helpful, concise, and solution-oriented. Acknowledge the concern and give a practical next step without inventing policies, promises, refunds, or timelines.

name: Reply to eBay or marketplace message
instruction: Treat the selected text as a buyer or seller message from eBay or another marketplace and draft my reply. Keep it concise, courteous, and transaction-focused. Do not invent item details, dispatch dates, tracking information, refunds, platform policies, or commitments, and do not assume whether I am the buyer or seller when the message does not make that clear.

name: Respond to complaint or problem
instruction: Draft a calm, professional response to the selected complaint or problem. Acknowledge the concern without automatically admitting fault, address the key issue, and propose a reasonable next step. Do not invent policies, compensation, or commitments.
